newsitem.title: INDIA: India SAIL share falls, net seen down.
newsitem.headline: India SAIL share falls, net seen down.

text.p: Shares of Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) fell in afternoon trade on Wednesday after the government forecast a lower net profit for the company in 1996/97, traders said.
At 0810 GMT the share was trading at 22.75 rupees, down from the day's high of 24.25 and compared to Tuesday's two percent rise to 23.25 at the Bombay Stock Exchange.

SAIL's net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) was estimated at 6.53 billion rupees, down from 13.19 billion in the previous fiscal year, according to a report by the Steel Ministry released on Wednesday.
For 1997/98, net profit is projected at 7.40 billion rupees, the ministry said in its annual performance budget.
SAIL shares were down 1.60 rupees to 22.90 at the National Stock Exchange with over 809,900 shares traded.
